note: The Library. Level 1 (`l1`: the screen `library`, state `all`) answers "how far have I come, and where?": every species of the catalogue in its state (unmet, met or found) on one grid, the wish's species and the species with looks new this visit marked, and the door to one species. Level 2 (`l2`: the screen `library.species`, states `sheet` and `lit`) answers "what do I know of this one, and what has it given me?": the generated sheet, the shelf (the wish, the face, the sittings, the families) and one chapter lit with its page. Level 3 (`library.family`) is not built yet: the frame draws it with its notBuilt composition. Rectangles are [x, y, w, h] in screen pixels; a cell's parts are offsets from the cell's origin. The face reads every rect, colour and picture id here; the props name what, never where.

screens.library.species: l2 (Level 2, one species: sheet and lit)

stage.draw: kit_stage: the flat ground, then the master over it once the host has sent it

grid.rule: cell i at x = 16 + 168 * (i mod 6), y = 57 + 168 * floor(i / 6), for S01 to S16 in species-number order; the form's first, pitch and grid are its cols, rows, cell, gap and origin as kit_tiles reads them (listPitch). Level 1 always shows the whole catalogue; another catalogue size is refused and comes back to UI/UX

cell.orderNote: the node order is fixed per cell, in this order, for all 16 cells; a part a state does not show is a node of no size (the dashed rule, hidden, keeps its box with no ops: kit_hairline's hidden form)

picture.when: found: the specimen grown as found; met: its pencil study; unmet: none

face.when: found, when faceOf is not null

wish.when: found or met, on the wished species; at `rect` with the face chip, at `alone` without

glint.when: found, with at least one look new this visit; kit_glint at kit_glint_level (16 levels over 2 s; solid under reduced motion)

cell.complete: a complete species shows a full specimen and no badge

cell.enabled: met and found cells only: an unmet cell is not a target, so the pad skips it

focus.initial: Home's species (from Home's Library bezel), the guide's species (from "Open the guide") or ui.lib.l1 (the Library room key); a species that is not a target gives the first target in species order; with none met there is no ring and ✓ does nothing
focus.memory: ui.lib.l1 = the species of the ring (host UI state)

keys.confirm: on a met or found cell: "Open {species}", to library.species (Level 2 of that species); ← there returns to Level 1 with the ring on that species
keys.back: Home, the ring on Home's Library bezel

line.subject: strings.subjects
line.slots: the frame's bottom line: action 16 to 392, the subject centred on 512 (at most 208 px and 6 words), the back room 68 px; every ✓ is named in the action slot; no digits

strings.subjectsNote: n is the looks new this visit across every species: one is "a new look"; two to six spell n (words.mjs); seven or more drop the count; none is empty; with no species met the subject is strings.subjects.none

every.pick: the first tier whose rows hold every trait group, a group never split across rows

picture.when: lit only, once made; drawn after the shelf nodes; a node of no size otherwise (sheet, met-only, and until the page lands)

l2.readout: frame.top.readout: the species mark species-mark-{SNN}-10 and the species' name
l2.orderNote: every node is drawn in this fixed order in every state; a part the state does not show is a node of no size (in lit every shelf node; on met-only every shelf node, every glint and the page); no node is ever missing

picture.node: sheet.picture: the sheet, or its lit variant in lit; until a picture is made the species' last made sheet, else the quiet stand-in library-quiet-{SNN}-{digest} (ground, surfaces, type and mosaic, no form); the unlit sheet stands in for a lit variant not yet made

glint.when: the looks new this visit, at most 8, in frame order

height.rule: drawn only when U = (w > 0 or face or s > 0); then h = head + gap + (w > 0 ? wish.pitch * w : 0) + (face ? face.size : 0) + (s > 0 ? sittings.row : 0) + between * (n - 1) + pad, n = (w > 0) + face + (s > 0) the rows drawn (w the wish pieces 0-4, face faceOf is not null, a released face counts, s the sittings 0-9), stacked wish, face, sittings; not U: every Unlocked node (the panel, the title, every wish, face and sittings node) is a node of no size in its fixed order and there is no h

disc.when: the found look's disc when a read carrier has the look, else the open disc

wish.when: piece k at y + 24 k; when this species holds the wish, a node of no size otherwise

focus.rule: [796, 88, 204, 24 w + 4]: the rect's h plus wish.pitch for each piece

face.y: y_f = 50 + head + gap + (w > 0 ? wish.pitch * w + between : 0)

sittings.when: s > 0; a record only (the UI/UX ruling: the 16 x 12 at y_s + 6, top and baseline shared with the label)

families.height: 30 + 12 + 80 r + 12, r = 1 or 2 rows; its top Y_F = U ? 50 + h + gap : 50 (the Unlocked shelf's top when it is not drawn); the faces and names keep their offsets from Y_F
families.tiles: kit_tiles over first, pitch and grid; a face's y is the shelf's top y_r plus the tile's
families.when: once the player has had a mibi of this species: at most 8, home first, then with the Companion, then released; the 8 most recent when there are more

chapter.enabled: every open plate; a shut plate is not listed

wish.enabled: sheet, when this species holds the wish (w > 0: the row is drawn); no target for a row not drawn

face.enabled: sheet, when faceOf is not null (the row is drawn); no target for a row not drawn

look.enabled: lit, the lit chapter's found looks only, in page order

focus.selectors: look.first: no resolver; the face takes the first listed look target
focus.initial: Level 2 always opens in sheet; the ring starts on ui.lib.l2[species] when it is among the targets, else on the first open chapter in frame order; on met-only there is none
focus.memory: ui.lib.l2[species]: in sheet written on each move; in lit it holds chapter.{lit} whatever the ring is on
focus.metOnly: no targets: focus.targets [], focus.cur ""; no ring

keys.confirm: on a plate in sheet: Show {Chapter}, to lit, the ring stays on the plate; on the lit plate: Clear {Chapter}, back to sheet; on another plate in lit: Show {Chapter}, the page swaps; on a look disc: nothing; on the wish: no ✓ until pinning has a screen (shut in place, nav.mjs); on the face: Look at {name} (the jump to that mibi up close) unless released; on a family face: See the family (library.family); met-only: nothing
keys.back: in lit: Clear, back to sheet with the ring on the lit chapter's plate; in sheet: Library, to Level 1 with the ring on this species
keys.lit: ✓ on a plate asks the logic process for the lit variant and the page; a ✓ before they land names the verb at once and shows each picture as it lands; a newer request supersedes

line.subject: strings.l2.subjects
line.slots: the frame's bottom line: every ✓ is named in the action slot; the subject at most 208 px and 6 words, never ending in an ellipsis; no digits (counts use words.mjs)

strings.namedRule: a named line (faceReleased.named, familyAt) that does not fit the subject (208 px, 6 words) gives its nameless line

carried.none: none of yours carries it yet
carried.rule: the first step that is at most 208 px and 6 words (ui/specs/measure.mjs over face/dist/metrics.json)

seen: newLooksOf (specimen-props.mjs) is the one definition of a new look for Home, Level 1 and the Level 2 glints. Entering Level 2 of species X (from Level 1, from Level 3 by ←, or by "Open the guide") sets the unsaved note ui.lib.pending[X] to X's guide looks in chapters not shut, as of that entry (a later entry to X replaces it; a met-only entry sets an empty note); leaving the Library (the first screen that is neither library nor library.*) adds only the species in the note to st.libSeen and saves. Entering the Library notes nothing; nothing is recorded on entry or inside the Library

faces.id: face:{mibi}:{size}, with :faded when that mibi is released
faces.rule: each size is rendered straight from the mibi's own picture (the layered stand's variant for its drawn looks) through the species' face window onto libGround; a 1 px libLine frame, the fog corner ticks at 40, 56 and 64 only; :faded is round(0.38 p + 0.62 libGround) per sRGB channel, frame included; opaque. Never one size faded and scaled to another. A species with no layered stand gets a labelled stand-in

windows._note: the art director's face windows, [x, y, side] in the 304 x 312 art's pixels, a square, transparent where it passes the art's edge (the layered stands only)
